name: gate_v1
doc: A gate in a wall (design/planner.md, Gates): the game asks for a type (a config entry: a palisade's gate, a town gate's arch, a gatehouse, a tower gate, a postern), the wall's kind it stands in (so it matches), and the opening's width (one a wall's model reports); build makes it across the opening, and the house animator opens its doors, sways its banners, and flickers its torches.

params.name: type
params.doc: A type: one entry from config/gate_v1_types/.

params.name: wall
params.doc: The wall it stands in: one entry from config/wall_v1_kinds/.

params.name: condition
params.doc: Intact, or a ruin: its doors and portcullis gone, broken down, overgrown.

params.name: width
params.doc: The opening along the wall's line (a wall model's gate_widths: 3 m, or more where openings merge).

params.name: detail
params.doc: Level of detail; the runtime picks it from distance and quality.

params.name: wind_heading
params.doc: Toward which the wind blows, from +Z toward +X.

params.name: door_time
params.doc: Seconds since its doors opened; negative while shut. The game starts it when someone comes through; it opens, stays a moment, and closes.
